Imran Khan has reportedly apologised after facing sharp criticism from the High Court over his participation in a protest. During the hearing, the court reprimanded him and questioned his right to take part in the demonstration. The court's remarks have sparked attention, raising questions about the circumstances surrounding the protest and the legal grounds for his participation. Why did Imran Khan have to apologise? What exactly did the High Court say, and why did it question his right to participate in the protest?
